title: Design System: Forever In Our Heart

display.purpose: The name on the cover only; capped at 10.5svh so it never meets the logo.

headline.purpose: Chapter titles on paper and cinema.

title.purpose: Service item titles, the honoured name, the guest-book title; reader and writing-dialog titles at smaller sizes.

card-title.purpose: Tribute titles on cards, under the Gold Ink card number.

numeral.purpose: Service item numbers; the darkroom year at larger scale.

script.purpose: Only the programme's script words: Hymn, Orin, Late.

tall.purpose: Only the word Biography in the hush.

body.purpose: Everything a guest reads; 17 to 19px, 66ch measure.

body-reader.purpose: A tribute opened in the reader; the largest reading size.

label.purpose: Uppercase column heads and officiant roles.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Tribute cards at rest; guest cards carry the hairline ring alone.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Tribute card under a fine pointer, with a 3px rise.

shadows.name: floating-bar
shadows.purpose: Sticky tab bar and floating language switch.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Reader and writing dialogs, over a rgb(20 9 3 / .62) backdrop.

shadows.name: film-play-disc
shadows.purpose: Large gold play disc over the film poster.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Search and text fields on focus, with a wine border.

shadows.name: candle-light
shadows.value: radial-gradient(circle, #FFF1C7 0 30%, rgb(240 180 78 / .55) 55%, rgb(240 180 78 / 0) 72%); box-shadow 0 0 14px 3px rgb(240 180 78 / .25), scaled per light
shadows.purpose: Each light in the Appreciation candle field. Literal candlelight; the only glow in the system.

shadows.name: candle-moment
shadows.value: radial-gradient(60% 60% at 50% 55%, rgb(240 180 78 / .14), rgb(30 14 5 / .35)), 2.6s rise and fade
shadows.purpose: Whole-page warm wash after a candle is lit.

motion.name: ease
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)
motion.purpose: House ease for all state changes.

motion.name: state
motion.value: 160ms
motion.purpose: Button, link, tab, toggle and field colour changes.

motion.name: press
motion.value: 120ms translateY(1px)

motion.name: tab-underline
motion.value: 240ms scaleX(0 to 1)

motion.name: reading-focus
motion.value: 360ms opacity .85 to 1
motion.purpose: Biography paragraph being read; player entrance.

motion.name: card-lift
motion.value: 260ms translateY(-3px); chevron translate 3px (200ms); press scale(.99)

motion.name: toast
motion.value: 260ms rise 1rem + fade

motion.name: dialog-in
motion.value: 380ms from translateY(18px) scale(.985) and transparent; under 700px from translateY(40px)
motion.purpose: Reader and writing dialogs; bottom sheet on phones.

motion.name: page-turn
motion.value: 380ms slide 24px + fade, in the direction of travel
motion.purpose: Reader previous/next, arrow keys and swipe.

motion.name: arrival
motion.value: 640ms rise 14px + opacity 0 to 1 (chapter titles 900ms from 22px); sibling stagger 55ms, max 5 steps; once, never on scroll back
motion.purpose: Every reading block coming into full ink as it reaches the reader. Off under reduced motion.

motion.name: photo-hover
motion.value: 600ms scale(1.035), saturate .92 to 1

motion.name: darkroom-develop
motion.value: scroll-driven --dev 0 to 1: sepia, brightness 1.15 to 1, contrast .55 to 1, saturate .4 to 1
motion.purpose: Biography prints developing as their paragraph is read.

motion.name: film-push
motion.value: scale 1.06 to 1.0 per 4s shot, alternating 1.2% drift, 1.2s dissolve, cubic-bezier(0.33, 0, 0.2, 1)

motion.name: film-framing
motion.value: portrait shown whole right of centre, sides feathered (16%) over blur(40px) brightness(.55) fill
motion.purpose: Portrait photographs in a widescreen frame.

motion.name: film-grade
motion.value: saturate(.86) contrast(1.04) sepia(.12), multiply brown vignette, soft-light brown wash

motion.name: film-words
motion.value: blur 8px to 0 and rise 14px over 24 to 30 frames; leave the same way
motion.purpose: Words arriving in the memorial film; the showreel carries no text.

motion.name: scroll-acts
motion.value: scrollcraft pin (1.5 viewports) and pan (5 viewports)
motion.purpose: Biography hush held; Photo Speak rail pans horizontally.

motion.name: flame
motion.value: unlit opacity .35 scale(.55); lit 400ms/600ms to full, then flicker on a 2.6s ease-in-out loop

motion.name: candle-glow
motion.value: 3.6s ease-in-out opacity .55 to 1, per-light delay; 1.2s during the candle moment

motion.name: equaliser
motion.value: 900ms ease-in-out scaleY(.3 to 1), three bars offset by 300ms

motion.name: new-guest-card
motion.value: 1.8s: 3px gold ring and 8px rise settling to the hairline

motion.name: film-play
motion.value: disc scale(1.06) 200ms on hover; overlay fades 300ms on play

motion.name: reading-progress
motion.value: scroll-linked scaleX(0 to 1) from the left, 2px gold
motion.purpose: Progress through the current chapter under the tabs.

motion.name: text-size
motion.value: html font-size 115%, remembered

narrative.overview:
The family's printed burial programme, re-set for screens as a film and a booklet that alternate. Deep programme-brown grounds carry the cinematic moments (the cover showreel, the Biography hush, the photo rail, the film, the closing Appreciation); warm cream paper carries everything that is read (the funeral service, the order, the liturgy and hymns, the life, the tributes). The palette, the four type voices and the section order are the printed booklet's own, not house defaults; the job of this system is to keep them and make them legible for an elder reading on a phone in a church.

Density is generous and calm. Body text never drops below 17px, every control is at least 48px, and reading columns hold a 66ch measure; a guest can raise all text by 15% from the tab bar. Gold behaves as light: hairline rules, numerals, the play control, the primary action, the reading-progress line, and the one place light is literal, the candles. Wine is the liturgy's voice, the selected state and the act of writing. Motion is slow and documentary (photographs push in, words develop out of blur, blocks rise once into full ink) and never surprises: nothing autoplays with sound, and reduced motion is honoured.

The memorial-template look (pastel hero, clip-art candle icon, an undifferentiated card grid as the page's structure) and a literal scan of the print (dense dot fields, crowded centred blocks) are both confirmed rejections. The tributes are opened as numbered programme entries in the booklet's order, and the candle is drawn as a living flame; neither is the template.
keyCharacteristics: Two grounds, cinema brown and cream paper, alternating by chapter; never a third.
Gold as light, deeper gold steps as text on paper.
Didone for names and headings, script only for the programme's own script words, a tall condensed face for the single Biography title, Red Hat Display for everything read.
Hairline rules and tonal panels for reading; quiet, hairline-ringed cards only for things a guest opens; pills for every touch control.
Real text over all video; the showreel and film poster carry no baked words.

rules.name: The Gold Is Light Rule
rules.body: Programme Gold never sets text on paper. Small gold text on paper uses Gold Ink; large gold text uses Gold Ink, Large; gold text on cinema uses Lamp Gold or Programme Gold at display size.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: Every chapter is either cinema or paper. Surfaces on paper go one tonal step: darker (Quiet Panel) for notes, lighter (Card Paper, Field White) for what a guest opens, writes in or chooses. Never a card on a card.

rules.name: The Brief-Pinned Palette Rule
rules.body: These colors are the printed programme's. Do not substitute "nicer" neutrals or add an accent; new needs are met from these roles. Wine, Lifted, Card Paper and Field White are steps of existing roles, not new voices.

rules.name: The Candlelight Rule
rules.body: Glow exists only as literal candlelight: the flame in the candle button, the field of candle lights behind the Appreciation, and the brief candle moment. Cream-white core, Lamp Gold body, fading to nothing. No glows on text, buttons, cards or photographs.

rules.name: The Four Voices Rule
rules.body: Didone for names, headings and numerals; script only where the programme sets script; the tall face only for "Biography"; Red Hat Display for everything a guest reads. No fifth face.

rules.name: The Elder Floor Rule
rules.body: Reading text is 17px minimum and 500 weight; nothing a guest must read goes below 0.9375rem except labels and player times, which are 800 and 700 weight. The larger-text toggle scales the root to 115% and every size follows.

rules.name: The Licensed-First Rule
rules.body: Every stack names the programme's licensed face before its stand-in. Keep that order.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows on paper are tinted programme brown (rgb 40 18 4, or the deeper rgb 20 9 3 for dialogs), soft and offset downward with negative spread. No grey, no hard offsets.

rules.name: The Dot Whisper Rule
rules.body: The print's dot pattern appears only as a 22px gold dot grid fading out over the top 22rem of a paper chapter. Never a full field.

rules.name: The Rest Is Flat Rule
rules.body: At rest a card is a hairline ring and at most a 2px whisper; lift appears only as a response to the pointer.

dos: Do set every reading surface on Reading Paper with Ink or Soft Ink text at 17px or more, 500 weight, 1.7 line height.
Do use Gold Ink (small) and Gold Ink, Large (large) whenever gold must be read on paper.
Do make every control at least 48px, and the primary ones 52 to 56px, as pills or circles.
Do carry grouping with hairline rules and a 1.5px gold leading rule rather than boxes; reserve cards for what a guest opens.
Do put all words over video in real markup, on a brown scrim weighted to where the words sit.
Do keep motion slow and documentary: pushes, dissolves, words developing out of blur, blocks rising once into full ink.
Do degrade missing audio to a disabled track reading "Instrumental coming soon".
Do put typing and choosing on Field White, and mark focus and selection in Liturgy Wine.
Do show one tribute at a time in the reader, at the reader's larger size, in programme order.
donts: Don't use the memorial template: pastel hero, clip-art candle icon, a card grid as the page's structure.
Don't reproduce the print literally: dense dot fields or crowded centred blocks.
Don't set Programme Gold as text on paper.
Don't use the script or tall faces outside the programme's own script words and the Biography title.
Don't nest cards, or add shadows to text panels on paper; a card lifts only under the pointer.
Don't autoplay sound, or bake text into the showreel or the film poster.
Don't spread Programme Red beyond the programme's single red tab.
Don't use glow anywhere but candlelight.
Don't replay arrivals on scroll back or under reduced motion.
